_doc: Gaps in committed or archived history that no real source can fill. Read by scripts/history_continuity.py: a missing period (or null required field) listed here is reported as DISCLOSED instead of failing the daily data-health run. Published at /health/known_gaps.json so the dashboard can disclose it. Add an entry only after trying every real source (git history of the file, the upstream's historical endpoint, the R2 archive, Internet Archive copies of the site) and say which in backfill_attempted. Never add a gap that can still be filled; fill it. `fillable: true` marks a gap that a named tool can still fill (see remedy) and is listed so the dashboard can say so until it is.

gaps.reason: No pages build ran 2026-08-19..21: run 844 wedged the old 'pages' concurrency group and every hourly run queued behind it. No snapshot was taken. Files for these days were created on 2026-10-04 holding only the indexes a real source reproduces (whale sentiments from the upstream daily series, ETF flow sentiments from the flow CSVs as committed that day, LTHCS composite from that day's committed index file); money_flow_index, crypto_signal_sentiment and poc_signal_breadth stay null.

Same mechanism for every crypto gap below. Root cause fixed by moving the cron from 22:00 to 12:00 UTC (lthcs-crypto-daily.yml).
